title: The FAA Logged 23 Serious Runway Near-Misses In One Year
hook: Serious runway danger more than doubled in about a decade.
closing: Every runway near-miss is a warning before the collision that cannot be undone.
question: Which airport risk worries you most?

segments.say: Safety officials logged 23 serious runway near-misses, roughly one every two weeks and more than double the pace about a decade earlier.
Six in ten runway incursions came from people or vehicles entering by mistake, showing why ground coordination drives the danger.
That runway danger clusters: just 8 airports, including Boston and Chicago Midway, hold almost a third of the worst near-misses.
